settings.heading: A Timeless Curation by
settings.bio: Dalljiet Kaur believes jewellery should make people feel seen, valued and connected. Her vision for Silver Play is to create a brand where silver feels luxurious, meaningful and relevant for modern life.
settings.name: Dalljiet Kaur

settings.text: Every Silver Play piece is handcrafted in 925 sterling silver — the international standard for fine silver jewellery. We work with natural, lightly finished stones wherever possible, because we believe the earth's imperfections are part of the beauty, not a flaw to be hidden. No two stones are identical.

Our collection spans a wide range of natural gemstones — each chosen for its visual character and the story it carries. Jaspers from across the world, Opals in colours that shift with the light, grounding stones like Pyrite and Tiger Eye, and rare finds like Scolecite and Purpurite.

settings.title: Slow Making
settings.body: We believe in slow making over mass production. Every piece takes the time real craft requires, shaped by hand rather than rushed off a line.

settings.title: Natural Over Synthetic
settings.body: We work with natural, lightly finished stones wherever possible — the earth's imperfections are part of the beauty, not a flaw to be hidden.

settings.title: Stories Over Trends
settings.body: We take pride in being transparent about what goes into each piece: the metal grade, the stone type, the craft involved, the story it carries.

settings.text: We are an independent Indian jewellery brand. We believe in slow making over mass production, in natural over synthetic, in stories over trends. We take pride in being transparent about what goes into each piece — the metal grade, the stone type, the craft involved. When you wear a Silver Play piece, you are wearing a moment of craft.

settings.quote: Silver Play's craftsmanship feels timeless, every piece like it was made just for me.
I wasn't expecting to feel emotional over a pendant, but the detailing genuinely stopped me. You can tell real hands made this.
I bought this for myself after a rough year and honestly, wearing it every day has made me feel a little more put-together.
Six months in and it still looks brand new. I was skeptical about silver holding up daily, but the anti-tarnish pouch tip actually works.
When the package arrives looking this beautiful, it's nothing short of overwhelming.

settings.text: Silver Play promises jewellery that is elegant, expressive and thoughtfully made. We create 925 silver pieces that feel premium, meaningful and easy to wear — jewellery that adds beauty to everyday moments, grace to celebrations and emotion to gifting. Because silver is not just something you wear. It is something you feel.
